subject: wizard_tower
summary: A tall, slender round stone tower. A wide upper lantern room with a projecting eave sits on the shaft, with pale recessed bays and a row of small lit openings below its roof. A tall pointed conical spire with a small finial rises from the lantern. Two small pointed-roof turrets stand on balconies projecting from the shaft at different heights, each with a pale tapering shape hanging beneath it. A pointed arched door is set low in the base of the shaft. The finished building must still read as a single slim shaft crowned by a lantern and spire, with the two side turrets clearly projecting from the sides.

shaft.where: Full height of the tower body, from the base up to the underside of the lantern.
shaft.notes: Round stone shaft, plain, rising straight under the lantern.

lantern.where: Wide upper room sitting on top of the shaft, with a projecting eave above it.
lantern.notes: Round upper room, wider than the shaft, with a projecting eave.

spire.where: Pointed conical roof on top of the lantern, rising to the finial.
spire.notes: Tall pointed conical spire over the lantern, ending in a finial.

side_turret.where: One on each side of the shaft, at different heights, standing on a balcony projecting from the shaft.
side_turret.notes: Small pointed-roof turret standing on its own balcony ledge.

door.where: Low on the front of the shaft, at ground level near the base.
door.notes: Pointed arched door, recessed into the shaft.

shaft_pilaster.where: Vertical strips running up the front of the shaft from the base to the lantern.
shaft_pilaster.notes: Vertical ribs standing proud of the shaft face.

balcony.where: Projects from the shaft on each side, below its turret, carried on an arched bracket.
balcony.notes: Stone ledge with an arched bracket beneath it.

drape.where: Hangs beneath each side turret's balcony ledge, tapering downward.
drape.notes: Pale tapering shape hanging below the balcony ledge.

lantern_window.where: Upper front of the lantern, centred among the pale bays.
lantern_window.notes: Arched window with a dark frame, set back in the wall.

lantern_bay.where: Pale bays on the lantern's upper front, either side of the arched window, reaching up to the eave.
lantern_bay.notes: Pale recessed panels between the lantern's pillars.

lit_opening.where: Lower band of the lantern, under the pale bays and just above the shaft.
lit_opening.notes: Small glowing openings set back between narrow pillars.

finial.where: Small cross or knob at the very tip of the spire.
finial.notes: Small upright finial on the spire tip.

verify_notes: Structure list matches both references: shaft, lantern, spire, turrets, balconies, drapes, door and finial are all present with correct built_as.
